answer:
Fixed! The bug was introduced in the modernize commit—tax was being applied to the full subtotal instead of the discounted amount. Changed line 11 in `src/invoice.js` from:

```javascript
const tax = computeTax(subtotal, region);
```

to:

```javascript
const tax = computeTax(subtotal - discount, region);
```

This restores the correct behavior where tax is computed on what the customer actually pays (after discount). Tests pass, and invoices with discount codes will now total correctly in regions with sales tax.
